rubric.criterion: Preserves the independently owned sales/support decisions instead of merging them solely because their current literals match.
Uses the supplied private caller evidence to remove the unused wrapper and consolidates the duplicate run instruction without inventing a broad redesign.
Preserves the local-mode prerequisite and useful rationale; verifies concrete policy outputs and checks the resulting newcomer instructions, distinguishing executed checks from unexecuted proposals.

Changes only the explicitly editable fixture files; preserves skill, adapter and verifier inputs; runs the supplied check and reports its actual outcome and limits without claiming production validation.
The supplied verifier succeeds against the changed fixture; saved command output and independent rerun substantiate the result. A proposed patch or invented test pass does not satisfy this criterion.
